Top dead centre (UP): the cam follower load passes through the shaft axis -> no holding torque (self-locking).

chain part as CC (frames, 2 chains, shafts, gear motor)
roller set: 8 rollers as RL in a lifting frame, gear motor 0.12 kW
eccentric shafts e = 15 mm with 2 cam followers each, coupled by chain

inductive sensors lift up / down + cam position
- Chain part (x, 800-leading) identical to CC (drawing D11)
- Roller set (y, 1200-leading): 8 rollers 60 at pitch 150 between the chains
- Down: rollers 15 below the chain top; up: 15 above (crate on rollers)
- Sensors: lift up / lift down / cam position (T5); TU1 adds load cells + contour frame (F4.3)
Combined FMS VC20 + RB - item F4.2 conveyors
TU transfer unit - section, lift positions, eccentric
